evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `declared_inventory` invokes `git ls-tree -r --name-only` without `-z` (or a `core.quotePath=false` override) and then parses the result with `splitlines()` and `startswith(TEMPLATE_DIR)`. Git's default pathname quoting renders non-ASCII template names as quoted C-style strings beginning with `"`, so a committed name such as `crq-tick-copy-é.timer` is dropped before the undeclared-template refusal check. This is an implementation bug in the existing inventory behavior; using `-z` and NUL splitting preserves the actual names.
